messages:
jules: Tiny poll: what would we name the office plant if it were an LLM? options: 'PhotosynthGPT', 'Fernformer', 'SporeBERT'. go. :seedling:

kai: PhotosynthGPT. it gives polite but passive-aggressive pruning tips. :leafy_green:

samir: Fernformer wins for me. it refuses to answer non-plant questions unless you water it first. :droplet: :joy:

jules: imagine a support reply: 'Did you try turning the soil? Also check your batch size.' :laughing:

ops-bot: Reaction poll created - react :one: PhotosynthGPT :two: Fernformer :three: SporeBERT. Poll ends in 12 hours.

kai: also can we add a Slack status sticker pack: "I'm photosynthesizing" for when the runtime is idle. :sun_with_face:

samir: memes i wrote: "Fernformer will not stop recommending 8-bit quantization until you hug it." :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

jules: new company policy idea: every time someone anthropomorphizes a model in #random, they must also drop a pun. keeps it civilized. :grin:

kai: pun incoming: "I told the model a dirt joke, it said it was humus-ly offended." :rofl:

samir: ok that's too good. I nominate this thread for the weekly roundup. :trophy:
